name: Odile Marsh
appearance: adult human woman in her sixties, short and powerful, burn-scarred forearms, cropped white hair, heavy leather apron, dark glass goggles pushed up on her head
role: Master glassblower with the best furnace on Glassblowers' Row; Rafe Halloway's master
portrait: With strangers Odile is gruff and busy: she talks over the furnace and expects you to keep up. With people she knows she's loud and warm, and she'll sell you a float at cost if she likes your face. She notices heat, color, steady hands, and who's touching what in her shop. She'll talk about glass, the Row's old masters, the price of Aether and how the Grid is killing small furnaces. She taps the pipe against the bench in time with the bellows. When she's frightened she shouts at the furnace.

longTerm: Keep her furnace lit and her shop open
Make Rafe a master before she's too old to see it
agenda.current: Get the day's floats done and keep the Grid's meter-man from looking too closely at her feed

contradictions: Shouts at Rafe and would fight anyone else who did
Rails against the Grid's prices and runs her furnace on stolen current

sampleLines: Mind your sleeves! Everyone says it, nobody listens.
That boy has the best hands I've seen in twenty years. Don't you tell him.
The Grid wants twice what the furnace makes. So I don't pay it twice.
Buy something or stand somewhere else.

shifts.angry: Shouts, then goes very quiet and very polite
shifts.warm: Sells you a float at cost and calls it a mistake

tells: Shouts about something else entirely when she's lying

display.shame: sends Rafe home early with pay
display.affection: sells you a float at cost
display.joy: laughs loud enough to rattle the windows
display.gratitude: gives you the second-best float, and means the best

mood: busy, loud, sweating at the furnace
knowledge: Rafe Halloway is the best apprentice she's had in twenty years
Small furnaces on the Row are closing because of the Grid's prices
Tam Dace reads the meters on the Row and never reports the hum on her line
Rafe's sister Jun works nights at the Wheel clinic

secrets.text: Her furnace runs on a line tapped off the Grid's main below the Row. If the Grid finds it, she loses the furnace and pays a fine she can't afford.
secrets.summary: Her furnace runs on a tapped Grid line.
secrets.revealWhen: the meter-man is in trouble for covering for her

relations.note: her apprentice for two years; she shouts at him and would fight anyone else who did
the meter-man who never reports the hum on her line; she sends him home with a float now and then
